_common_bg: Photorealistic photograph, 4:3 landscape, shot on 35mm color film in Japan in 1994, natural grain, realistic lighting, no people, no animals, no text, no signs with readable letters, no logos, no watermark.
_common_sil: A single full-body human silhouette: completely flat solid black shape on a pure white background, no interior detail, no gradients, no ground shadow, no text. The whole figure from head to feet is visible, centered, standing, filling most of the height. Portrait orientation 2:3.

bg.bus: Inside an old rural Japanese route bus, view from a rear seat toward the front windshield, the bus climbing a narrow mountain road through a misty autumn valley, red and yellow maple leaves, overcast late afternoon, rain drops on the windows.
bg.valley: A deep forested mountain valley in Japan in autumn at dusk, thick white fog drifting between steep slopes, a swollen muddy river far below, overcast sky, moody and quiet.
bg.bridge: An old concrete road bridge with rusty railings over a swollen brown mountain river in a misty Japanese valley at dusk, light rain, a single small street lamp, forest on both banks.
bg.inn_dusk: Exterior of a large old two-story traditional Japanese wooden hot-spring inn (ryokan) in a misty mountain valley at dusk, dark wooden walls, tiled roof, warm lights in the paper windows, a stone path to the entrance, light rain, wet stones.
bg.inn_storm: Exterior of a large old traditional Japanese wooden hot-spring inn at night during a violent typhoon, heavy slanted rain, trees bending in the wind, a few warm lit windows, dark sky, wet ground reflecting light.
bg.genkan: Entrance hall (genkan) of an old Japanese ryokan at evening, polished dark wooden floor, a step up from the stone floor, rows of slippers, a wooden reception counter with an old black telephone and a guest register book, paper lantern lights.
bg.lobby: Lounge of an old Japanese mountain ryokan at night, an irori sunken hearth with a hanging kettle, low wooden tables, an old tall pendulum wall clock, framed old black-and-white photographs on the wooden wall, warm dim lamps, rain on dark windows.
bg.lobby_dark: Lounge of an old Japanese mountain ryokan during a power outage at night, lit only by a few candles and a kerosene lamp on a low table, an irori hearth with glowing embers, a tall pendulum clock in deep shadow, very dark, warm small pools of light.
bg.corridor: A long polished wooden corridor of an old Japanese ryokan at night, dim warm lamps, a row of rain-streaked glass windows on one side showing a dark garden, reflections on the floor.
bg.corridor_dark: A long wooden corridor of an old Japanese ryokan in total darkness during a power outage, lit only by a flashlight beam from the viewer, the far end disappearing into blackness, rain on the windows, eerie.
bg.stairs: A steep old wooden staircase inside a traditional Japanese inn at night, worn polished steps, a dim lamp on the landing above, dark shadows.
bg.room: A traditional Japanese tatami guest room in an old ryokan at evening, a low table with a tea set, floor chairs, a tokonoma alcove with a hanging scroll, shoji screens, a window with rain and dark mountains outside.
bg.room_night: A traditional Japanese tatami guest room at night with futon bedding laid out, lit only by a small floor lamp (andon), shoji screens, deep shadows, rain on the window.
bg.dining: A large tatami banquet hall in an old Japanese ryokan in the evening, individual low lacquered trays with an elaborate autumn kaiseki dinner (matsutake, grilled river fish, small dishes, a sake flask), warm light, sliding doors.
bg.kitchen: The kitchen of an old Japanese ryokan at night, stainless counters and old wooden cutting boards, big pots on gas burners, knives on a magnetic bar, a small old transistor radio on a shelf, steam, a single fluorescent light.
bg.kitchen_dark: A dark empty kitchen of an old Japanese inn at night, a big pot quietly steaming on a low gas flame, a small old radio glowing on a shelf, everything else in deep shadow, eerie.
bg.office: A small cluttered back office of a Japanese inn at night, an old desk with ledgers, a commercial two-way radio transceiver with a hand microphone, a wall calendar, a fluorescent desk lamp, rain on a dark window.
bg.bath: Indoor hot-spring bath of a Japanese ryokan at night, a large stone tub with steaming water, wooden walls, large windows to a dark rainy garden, soft light, steam.
bg.garden: A Japanese inn garden at night in heavy rain, a stone lantern, wet maple trees, a roofed wooden covered walkway crossing the garden toward a dark old wooden bathhouse, puddles reflecting faint light.
bg.watari: Inside a long roofed wooden covered walkway (watari-rouka) between two old Japanese buildings at night in a storm, rain blowing in from the open sides, old planks, a single bare bulb, darkness at the far end.
bg.oldbath_ext: An old Meiji-era wooden Japanese bathhouse at dusk, weathered dark boards, a small bronze bell hanging under the eaves, a closed wooden sliding door, a bunch of white chrysanthemums laid on the stone step, mossy stones, misty forest behind.
bg.oldbath: Interior of an old abandoned wooden Japanese bathhouse in the late afternoon, a large empty cypress-wood bathtub, completely drained and dry, old wooden walls and beams, dusty light from a high window, quiet and melancholic.
bg.oldbath_night: Interior of an old wooden Japanese bathhouse at night, a large cypress-wood bathtub overflowing with hot water, thick steam filling the room, water spilling across the wooden floor, lit only by a flashlight, ominous, no people.
bg.bell: Close-up of a small old bronze bell hanging from dark wooden rafters under the eaves of an old Japanese wooden building at night, rain dripping, a thin weathered rope, dramatic light from below.
bg.kamaba: A cramped old boiler and valve room of a Japanese hot spring, rusty iron pipes, a large red hand-wheel valve, a pressure gauge, wet concrete floor, a dim bulb, steam.
bg.annex: A short covered wooden corridor leading to a separate small detached guest room of an old Japanese inn at night, a paper lantern beside the sliding door, rain, a small moss garden.
bg.annex_room: A scholar's tatami guest room in an old Japanese inn at night, a low desk covered in old books, notebooks, a magnifying glass and handwritten papers, stacks of folklore books, a desk lamp, shoji screens.
bg.cellar: Steep old stone steps leading down into a dark sake storage cellar under a Japanese inn, large wooden sake barrels, damp stone walls, a single bare bulb, deep shadows.
bg.storeroom: A dusty storeroom in an old Japanese inn, wooden shelves with old ledgers and guest registers bound in string, cardboard boxes, a dim window, cobwebs.
bg.gondo_room: A small plain room of an old cook behind an inn kitchen, a tiny Buddhist altar (butsudan) with a candle, incense and a small framed old black-and-white photograph of a smiling teenage girl, a folded futon, a kitchen apron hanging on a nail.
bg.window_storm: A rain-lashed old wooden window of a Japanese inn at night, a bright lightning bolt in the dark sky over black mountains, water streaming on the glass.
bg.river_night: A violently flooded mountain river at night, brown water roaring over rocks, broken branches, a faint light from a flashlight, rain, dangerous.
bg.landslide: A narrow mountain road in Japan buried by a landslide of mud, rocks and fallen trees at dusk in heavy rain, a guardrail bent, impassable.
bg.dawn: A misty mountain valley in Japan at dawn after a typhoon, the rain stopped, pale golden sunlight breaking through clouds, wet autumn trees, fog rising from the river, calm and clean.
bg.inn_dawn: Exterior of an old traditional Japanese wooden hot-spring inn at dawn after a storm, wet roof shining, pale sky, fog in the valley, fallen leaves and branches on the stone path.
bg.polaroid: A single instant-film photograph lying on a dark wooden table under a lamp. The small square photo shows a steamy dark bathhouse lit by a camera flash, and a very thin pale string line runs vertically from a bell in the rafters down into the water. Shallow depth of field.
bg.diary: An old handwritten Japanese diary from 1969 lying open on a desk, faded brown ink in vertical lines of brush-pen handwriting (illegible), yellowed paper, a reading lamp, close-up.
bg.oldphoto: An old sepia group photograph from 1969 pinned on a wooden wall: staff of a Japanese ryokan in kimono and cook's whites standing in front of the inn, faces small and slightly blurred, scratched and faded.
bg.office_tokyo: A cluttered Japanese magazine editorial office in Tokyo in 1994, desks piled with papers and magazines, CRT word processors, ashtrays, fluorescent light, late afternoon.
bg.train_window: View from a train window of a Japanese rural line in autumn, mountains and rice fields under a grey sky, rain streaks on the glass.
bg.edo_bath: Interior of a Japanese bathhouse in the late Edo period at night, a big wooden tub, oil lamps, wooden walls, steam, traditional and historical, no modern objects.
bg.bus_door: Inside an old rural Japanese route bus that has stopped in heavy rain at dusk, seen from the aisle near the front: the folding front door is open, and through it and the rain-streaked windshield an old concrete bridge with rusty red-brown railings crosses a swollen muddy river in a misty forested valley; worn seats in the foreground, dim interior lights.
bg.bridge_walk: Standing on an old narrow concrete road bridge in a misty Japanese mountain valley at dusk in the rain, eye-level view along the bridge deck from one end, rusty red-brown railings on both sides, wet road surface reflecting a single small street lamp, a swollen brown river visible below the railing on one side, forested slopes and fog beyond, the far end of the bridge leading to a wooded slope.
bg.cz_home: The small living room of a modest rented wooden house in a Japanese mountain village, kept exactly as in the late 1960s, before dawn: worn tatami, a low round chabudai table with rice bowls and a teapot, a bare light bulb hanging from the ceiling, sliding shoji and fusuma doors, a small old valve radio on a chest of drawers, a calendar on the wall, a narrow earthen-floored kitchen visible through an open door with a wood-fired stove, blue pre-dawn light at the window.

sil.chihiro: A woman of about 30 with short bob hair, a loose jacket and slim trousers, a camera hanging from a strap on her shoulder, standing relaxed with weight on one leg.
sil.chihiro2: A woman of about 30 with short bob hair and a jacket, holding a camera up to her face as if taking a photograph, side view.
sil.shino: A woman in her late fifties in a traditional Japanese kimono with her hair in a neat bun, standing very upright with hands folded in front.
sil.keisuke: A man in his early thirties wearing a happi coat over a sweater and trousers, one hand on his hip, standing.
sil.gondo: A stocky man in his sixties wearing a Japanese cook's white coat and a tied headband, arms hanging, slightly hunched, standing.
sil.gondo2: A stocky man in his sixties wearing a cook's white coat and headband, holding a large log of firewood raised in one hand, menacing.
sil.sayo: A young woman of about 19 in a ryokan maid's kimono with an apron and a high ponytail, holding a tray, standing.
sil.kugayama: A heavy-set man in his late forties wearing a yukata robe, holding a sake cup, chin raised arrogantly, standing.
sil.shiga: A thin old man in his seventies with round glasses and a walking cane, wearing a cardigan and slacks, slightly stooped, standing.
sil.ryo: A slim young man of about 28 with tidy hair in a sweater and slacks, hands in pockets, standing nervously.
sil.emi: A young woman of about 26 with long hair, wearing a cardigan and a long skirt, arms wrapped around herself, standing.
sil.sumiko: A woman of about 35 with long straight hair down her back, wearing a long plain dress, standing still with arms at her sides.
sil.sumiko2: A woman with very long straight hair wearing a long loose yukata robe, holding a candle in front of her with both hands, standing still, ghostly posture.
sil.chizuru: A girl of about 17 in a 1960s ryokan maid's kimono with an apron, her hair tied back, smiling and standing.
sil.oyura: A girl of about 16 in a late Edo-period kimono with long loose hair falling forward over her face, standing with her head bowed, arms hanging.
sil.driver: An old man bus driver wearing a uniform cap and jacket, standing.
sil.boku: A young man of about 24 in a casual jacket with a shoulder bag and a notebook in hand, standing.
sil.gondo_y: A sturdy man of about 36 with short cropped hair, wearing a Japanese cook's white coat and a tied headband, arms crossed, standing.
sil.shino_y: A slender woman of about 33 in a traditional Japanese kimono with her hair in a neat bun, standing very upright with hands folded in front.
sil.tatsuya: A tall slim young man of about 22 with longish 1960s hair, wearing a loose yukata robe, holding a sake bottle, slouching arrogantly, standing.
sil.sumiko10: A small girl of about 10 with a short bob haircut, a pinafore dress and a school randoseru backpack, standing.
sil.keichan: A small boy of about 7 with a close-cropped haircut, in shorts, a sweater and knee socks, hands behind his back, standing.
sil.haha: A woman of about 38 in a 1960s kappogi apron over a plain kimono, her hair tied back, standing.
sil.oodanna: A thin stern old man of about 65 in a kimono with a haori jacket, hands clasped behind his back, standing.
